gebco_citation: GEBCO Bathymetric Compilation Group2026(2026), GEBCO_2026 Grid, doi:10.5285/4f68d5c7-45eb-f999-e063-7086abc036fa.
screen_definition: Reject native depth plus8m support margin deeper than point-grid bed, or deeper than6+0.85*(bed-6). The6m draft is source paper context. The8m margin is an explicit conservative half-support scenario based on the paper's8/16m bin configurations, not a recovered per-ping cell size or uncertainty.
footprint_definition: At each ensemble use the shallowest GEBCO depth within circular radius point_depth*tan30deg+400m. Circular envelope avoids assuming beam azimuth;400m is a grid footprint allowance, not a confidence margin. Require whole envelope inside the bounded tile. It does not resolve subgrid slopes or prove all sidelobes removed.
datum_limit: GEBCO assumes heterogeneous source elevations referred to mean sea level; some shallow sources differ. ADCP depths use local sea-surface context. No tide, geoid or time-varying sea-level correction is recovered. Gridded bathymetry is a screening approximation, not ship bottom-track observations or proof of physical current boundaries.
processing: Mask native rows before spatial selection and smoothing. Preserve prior1km representative selection, nine PG/window combinations and two-jet candidate segmentation. No vertical filling or bottom extrapolation.
